card.name: Words linking an agent to its effect
card.fires_on: Verbs of effect (affect, reduce, increase) and the small word right after them (the, on), where one substance acts on another's levels or risk. Seen mostly in drug-interaction text and alcohol-and-cancer text.

modes.label: Effect verbs
modes.description: The verb saying one drug or substance changes another, such as affect, reduce or increases.
modes.example: Triazolam: Fluconazole<< increases>> the AUC of triazolam

modes.label: Word after the verb
modes.description: The word right after an effect verb, before the thing being changed.
modes.example: Alcohol increases<< the>> risk of mouth, throat, voice box

modes.label: Interaction headings
modes.description: The middle of the heading 'Potential for Other Drugs to Affect' in the drug-interaction section.
modes.example: 7.2 Potential for Other Drugs to A<<ffect>> EVOTAZ Atazanavir
